title: "About This Website"
---


This website serves as a professional portfolio showcasing my academic work, research projects, and interests in public health, global health, and data science.

It was developed using **R Markdown** and deployed through :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0} Pages to provide a clean, accessible platform for presenting my work to a broad audience.

---

## Purpose

The purpose of this site is to:

- Present my graduate-level projects in a clear and accessible format  
- Highlight my work in public health and data science  
- Provide access to my thesis, dashboard, and professional experience  
- Demonstrate my ability to communicate complex ideas to a general audience  

---

## Audience

This website is intended for:

- Public health professionals  
- Researchers and academics  
- Policy makers and community stakeholders  
- Potential collaborators and employers  

---

## Design & Features

This site includes:

- A structured navigation bar for easy access to all pages  
- Custom styling using CSS to enhance layout and readability  
- Project showcases using structured content and visual organization  
- Links to external platforms such as GitHub and LinkedIn  

---

## Technical Approach

The website was built using:

- R Markdown for content development  
- HTML and CSS for layout customization  
- GitHub Pages for hosting and deployment
